item.tib: khyed brjod dri med pad dkar
item.coloph: ces pa'i khyed brjod dri med pad dkar 'di/ drin chen mtshungs med khyung po'i gdung spral pa'i/ g.yung drung phun tshogs nyid kyi spyan sngar ru/ 'dun bu nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ming gis phul te 'dun bu'i rig blo'i rtsal zhan pas/ ma rig sdig nyes 'gal 'khrul bzod gsol bzhes/ dgyes pa'i tshul gyis byin gyis rlobs mdzod la/ dad ldan mos 'dun rnams la spel ba dang*/ bdag la'ang na rjes gnang mdzad par zhu// dge'o//
